mapper.insert: insert into tb_news(title, link, keyword_list, description, pubDate) values (#{title}, #{link}, #{keyword}, #{description}, #{pubDate, jdbcType=OTHER}) on conflict (link) do update set keyword_list = CASE WHEN tb_news.keyword_list not like concat('%', EXCLUDED.keyword_list, '%') THEN concat(tb_news.keyword_list, ', ', EXCLUDED.keyword_list) ELSE tb_news.keyword_list END
